ayahs.textArabic: وَالذّٰرِيٰتِ ذَرْوًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Waż-żāriyāti żarwā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: CONSIDER the winds that scatter the dust far and wide,

ayahs.textArabic: فَالْحٰمِلٰتِ وِقْرًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fal-ḥāmilāti wiqrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and those that carry the burden [of heavy clouds],

ayahs.textArabic: فَالْجٰرِيٰتِ يُسْرًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fal-jāriyāti yusrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and those that speed along with gentle ease,

ayahs.textArabic: فَالْمُقَسِّمٰتِ اَمْرًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fal-muqassimāti amrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and those that apportion [the gift of life] at [God’s] behest!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّمَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لَصَادِقٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innamā tū‘adūna laṣādiq(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, that which you are promised is true indeed,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاِنَّ الدِّيْنَ لَوَاقِعٌۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innad-dīna lawāqi‘(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: and, verily, judgment is bound to come!

ayahs.textArabic: وَالسَّمَاۤءِ ذَاتِ الْحُبُكِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Was-samā'i żātil-ḥubuk(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: CONSIDER the firmament full of starry paths!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّكُمْ لَفِيْ قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innakum lafī qaulim mukhtalif(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, [O men,] you are deeply at variance as to what to believe:

ayahs.textArabic: يُّؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ اُفِكَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Yu'faku ‘anhu man ufik(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: perverted in his views thereon is he who would deceive himself!

ayahs.textArabic: قُتِلَ الْخَرَّاصُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qutilal-kharrāṣūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They but destroy themselves, they who are given to guessing at what they cannot ascertain –

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ هُمْ فِيْ غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna hum fī gamratin sāhūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: they who blunder along, in ignorance lost –

ayahs.textArabic: يَسْـَٔلُوْنَ اَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الدِّيْنِۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Yas'alūna ayyāna yaumud-dīn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: they who [mockingly] ask, “When is that Day of Judgment to be?”

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ يُفْتَنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma hum ‘alan-nāri yuftanūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [It will be] a Day when they will be sorely tried by the fire,

ayahs.textArabic: ذُوْقُوْا فِتْنَتَكُمْۗ هٰذَا الَّذِيْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Żūqū fitnatakum, hāżal-lażī kuntum bihī tasta‘jilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and will be told:] “Taste this your trial! It is this that you were so hastily asking for!”

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-muttaqīna fī jannātiw wa ‘uyūn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But,] behold, the God-conscious will find themselves amid gardens and springs,

ayahs.textArabic: اٰخِذِيْنَ مَآ اٰتٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۗ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِيْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Ākhiżīna mā ātāhum rabbuhum, innahum kānū qabla żālika muḥsinīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: enjoying all that their Sustainer will have granted them [because], verily, they were doers of good in the past:

ayahs.textArabic: كَانُوْا قَلِيْلًا مِّنَ الَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Kānū qalīlam minal-laili mā yahja‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: they would lie asleep during but a small part of the night,

ayahs.textArabic: وَبِالْاَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa bil-asḥāri hum yastagfirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and would pray for forgiveness from their innermost hearts;

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِيْٓ اَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّاۤىِٕلِ وَالْمَحْرُوْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa fī amwālihim ḥaqqul lis-sā'ili wal-maḥrūm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [would assign] in all that they possessed a due share unto such as might ask [for help] and such as might suffer priva­tion.

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِى الْاَرْضِ اٰيٰتٌ لِّلْمُوْقِنِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa fil-arḍi āyātul lil-mūqinīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND ON EARTH there are signs [of God’s exis­tence, visible] to all who are endowed with inner certainty,

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِيْٓ اَنْفُسِكُمْ ۗ اَفَلَا تُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa fī anfusikum, afalā tubṣirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: just as [there are signs thereof] within your own selves: can you not, then, see?

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِى السَّمَاۤءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa fis-samā'i rizqukum wa mā tū‘adūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And in heaven is [the source of] your sus­tenance [on earth] and [of] all that you are promised [for your life after death]:

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاۤءِ وَالْاَرْضِ اِنَّهٗ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ اَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa wa rabbis-samā'i wal-arḍi innahū laḥaqqum miṡla mā annakum tanṭiqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, by the Sustainer of heaven and earth, this [life after death] is the very truth - as true as that you are endowed with speech!

ayahs.textArabic: هَلْ اَتٰىكَ حَدِيْثُ ضَيْفِ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ الْمُكْرَمِيْنَۘ
ayahs.textLatin: Hal atāka ḥadīṡu ḍaifi ibrāhīmal-mukramīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND HAS the story of Abraham’s honoured guests ever come within thy ken?

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ دَخَلُوْا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْا سَلٰمًا ۗقَالَ سَلٰمٌۚ قَوْمٌ مُّنْكَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż dakhalū ‘alaihi fa qālū salāmā(n), qāla salām(un), qaumum munkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: When those [heavenly messengers] came unto him and bade him peace, he answered, “[And upon you be] peace!” - [saying to himself,] “They are strangers.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَرَاغَ اِلٰٓى اَهْلِهٖ فَجَاۤءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِيْنٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Farāga ilā ahlihī fa jā'a bi‘ijlin samīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Then he turned quietly to his household, and brought forth a fat [roasted] calf,

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَرَّبَهٗٓ اِلَيْهِمْۚ قَالَ اَلَا تَأْكُلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa qarrabahū ilaihim, qāla alā ta'kulūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and placed it before them, saying, “Will you not eat?”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيْفَةً  ۗقَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْۗ وَبَشَّرُوْهُ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa aujasa minhum khīfah(tan), qālū lā takhaf, wa basysyarūhu bigulāmin ‘alīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And when he saw that the guests would not eat,] he became apprehensive of them; [but] they said, “Fear not” - and gave him the glad tiding of [the birth of] a son who would be endowed with deep knowledge.

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَقْبَلَتِ امْرَاَتُهٗ فِيْ صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوْزٌ عَقِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa aqbalatimra'atuhū fī ṣarratin fa ṣakkat wajhahā wa qālat ‘ajūzun ‘aqīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon his wife approached [the guests] with a loud cry, and struck her face [in astonishment] and exclaimed: “A barren old woman [like me]!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا كَذٰلِكِۙ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۗاِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْحَكِيْمُ الْعَلِيْمُ  ۔
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū każālik(i), qāla rabbuk(i), innahū huwal-ḥakīmul-‘alīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: “Thus has thy Sustainer decreed; and, verily, He alone is truly wise, all- knowing!”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ اَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhal-mursalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Abraham]: “And what [else] may you have in view, O you [heavenly] messengers?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْآ اِنَّآ اُرْسِلْنَآ اِلٰى قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū innā ursilnā ilā qaumim mujrimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: “Behold, we have been sent unto a people lost in sin,

ayahs.textArabic: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّنْ طِيْنٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Linursila ‘alaihim ḥijāratam min ṭīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: to let loose upon them stone-hard blows of chastisement,

ayahs.textArabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Musawwamatan ‘inda rabbika lil-musrifīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: marked out in thy Sustainer’s sight for [the punishment of] such as have wasted their own selves.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَخْرَجْنَا مَنْ كَانَ فِيْهَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa akhrajnā man kāna fīhā minal-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And in the course of time We brought out [of Lot ’s city] such [few] believers as were there:

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيْهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Famā wajadnā fīhā gaira baitim minal-muslimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for apart from one [single] house We did not find there any who had surrendered themselves to Us.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيْهَآ اٰيَةً لِّلَّذِيْنَ يَخَافُوْنَ الْعَذَابَ الْاَلِيْمَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa taraknā fīhā āyatal lil-lażīna yakhāfūnal-‘ażābal-alīm(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so We left therein a message for those who fear the grievous suffering [which awaits all evildoers].

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِيْ مُوْسٰىٓ اِذْ اَرْسَلْنٰهُ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa fī mūsā iż arsalnāhu ilā fir‘auna bisulṭānim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND IN [the story of Pharaoh and] Moses, too, [We left the same message: for] when We sent him unto Pharaoh with [Our] manifest authority,

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَوَلّٰى بِرُكْنِهٖ وَقَالَ سٰحِرٌ اَوْ مَجْنُوْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa tawallā biruknihī wa qāla sāḥirun au majnūn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: and he turned away in [the pride of] his power and said, “A sorcerer [is this Moses], or a madman!” –

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَخَذْنٰهُ وَجُنُوْدَهٗ فَنَبَذْنٰهُمْ فِى الْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيْمٌۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa akhażnāhu wa junūdahū fanabażnāhum fil-yammi wa huwa mulīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: We seized him and his hosts, and cast them all into the sea: and [none but Pharaoh] himself was to blame [for what happened].

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِيْ عَادٍ اِذْ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيْحَ الْعَقِيْمَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa fī ‘ādin iż arsalnā ‘alaihimur-rīḥal-‘aqīm(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [you have the same message] in [what happened to the tribe of] Ad, when We let loose against them that life-destroying wind

ayahs.textArabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ اَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ اِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيْمِۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā tażaru min syai'in atat ‘alaihi illā ja‘alathu kar-ramīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: which spared nothing of what it came upon, but caused [all of] it to become like bones dead and decayed.

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِيْ ثَمُوْدَ اِذْ قِيْلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوْا حَتّٰى حِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa fī ṡamūda iż qīla lahum tamatta‘ū ḥattā ḥīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And in [the story of the tribe of] Thamud, too, when they were told, “You shall enjoy your life for [but] a little while,”

ayahs.textArabic: فَعَتَوْا عَنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa‘atau ‘an amri rabbihim fa akhażathumuṣ-ṣā‘iqatu wa hum yanẓurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: after they had turned with disdain from their Sustainer’s commandment - whereupon the thunderbolt of punishment overtook them while they were [helplessly] looking on:

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوْا مِنْ قِيَامٍ وَّمَا كَانُوْا مُنْتَصِرِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Famastaṭā‘ū min qiyāmiw wa mā kānū muntaṣirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for they were unable even to rise, and could not defend themselves.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوْحٍ مِّنْ قَبْلُ ۗ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا فٰسِقِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qauma nūḥim min qabl(u), innahum kānū qauman fāsiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [thus, too, We destroyed] Noah’s people aforetime: for they were iniquitous folk.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالسَّمَاۤءَ بَنَيْنٰهَا بِاَيْىدٍ وَّاِنَّا لَمُوْسِعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Was-samā'a banaināhā bi'aidiw wa innā lamūsi‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND IT IS We who have built the universe with [Our creative] power; and, verily, it is We who are steadily expanding it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالْاَرْضَ فَرَشْنٰهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمٰهِدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-arḍa farasynāhā fa ni‘mal-māhidūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And the earth have We spread out wide - and how well have We ordered it!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa min kulli syai'in khalaqnā zaujaini la‘allakum tażakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And in everything have We created oppos­ites, so that you might bear in mind [that God alone is One].

ayahs.textArabic: فَفِرُّوْٓا اِلَى اللّٰهِ ۗاِنِّيْ لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa firrū ilallāh(i), innī lakum minhu nażīrum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so, [O Muhammad, say unto them:] “Flee unto God [from all that is false and evil]! Verily, I am a plain warner to you from Him!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوْا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَۗ اِنِّيْ لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā taj‘alū ma‘allāhi ilāhan ākhar(a), innī lakum minhu nażīrum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And do not ascribe divinity to aught side by side with God: verily, I am a plain warner to you from Him!”

ayahs.textArabic: كَذٰلِكَ مَآ اَتَى الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا قَالُوْا سَاحِرٌ اَوْ مَجْنُوْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Każālika mā atal-lażīna min qablihim mir rasūlin illā qālū sāḥirun au majnūn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But] thus it is: never yet came any apostle to those who lived before their time but they said, “A spellbinder [Lit., "sorcerer".] [is he], or a madman!”

ayahs.textArabic: اَتَوَاصَوْا بِهٖۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Atawāṣau bih(ī), bal hum qaumun ṭāgūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Have they, perchance, handed down this [way of thinking] as a legacy unto one another? Nay, they are people filled with overweening ar­rogance!

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ اَنْتَ بِمَلُوْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa tawalla ‘anhum famā anta bimalūm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Turn, then, away from them, and thou shalt incur no blame;

ayahs.textArabic: وَذَكِّرْ فَاِنَّ الذِّكْرٰى تَنْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa żakkir fa innaż-żikra  tanfa‘ul-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: yet go on reminding [all who would listen]: for, verily, such a reminder will profit the believers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْاِنْسَ اِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā khalaqtul-jinna wal-insa illā liya‘budūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [tell them that] I have not created the invisible beings and men to any end other than that they may [know and] worship Me.

ayahs.textArabic: مَآ اُرِيْدُ مِنْهُمْ مِّنْ رِّزْقٍ وَّمَآ اُرِيْدُ اَنْ يُّطْعِمُوْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā urīdu minhum mir rizqiw wa mā urīdu ay yuṭ‘imūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But withal,] no sustenance do I ever demand of them, nor do I demand that they feed Me:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِيْنُ
ayahs.textLatin: Innallāha huwar-razzāqu żul-quwwatil-matīn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, verily, God Himself is the Provider of all sustenance, the Lord of all might, the Eternal!

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِنَّ لِلَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا ذَنُوْبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوْبِ اَصْحٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُوْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa inna lil-lażīna ẓalamū żanūbam miṡla żanūbi aṣḥābihim falā yasta‘jilūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, verily, they who are bent on doing evil shall have their share [of evil] like unto the share of their fellows [of old]: so let them not ask Me to hasten [their doom]!

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ يَّوْمِهِمُ الَّذِيْ يُوْعَدُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa wailul lil-lażīna kafarū miy yaumihimul-lażī yū‘adūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: For, woe unto those who are bent on denying the truth - [woe] on the Day which they have been promised
